result.title: Bridging Neural Tangent Kernel Analysis and Reinforcement Learning for Deep Function Approximation
result.summary: Despite their widespread success across machine learning, the learning dynamics and generalization properties of neural networks remain poorly understood. The neural tangent kernel (NTK) provides an analytical characterization of the learning dynamics of infinitely wide neural networks and serves as a useful proxy for finite-width networks in supervised learning. In this work, we extend the NTK framework to reinforcement learning (RL) by introducing a temporal-difference (TD) flow formulation that accommodates time-varying mini-batches and TD targets, yielding a closed-form solution for value function evolution in an overparametrized setting. We also devise an optimization-based state-space exploration method that leverages the closed-form solution, coupled with constraints on the environment, to model the set of feasible states. On a deterministic grid environment, we validate that the proposed RL-based NTK formulation is indeed learning efficiently and adapting to the distribution shift in the training data distribution, and we demonstrate that the resulting exploration strategy improves sample efficiency. To our knowledge, this is the first work to extend NTK theory to characterize the learning dynamics of RL training with time-varying mini-batches and TD updates.

AI.brief_summary: 该文把 NTK 框架扩展到强化学习，提出 TD flow 表述以处理时变小批量与 TD 目标，在过参数化下给出值函数演化的闭式解，并据此设计基于优化的状态空间探索方法，在确定性网格环境中验证有效性与样本效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「时变监督目标下的闭式训练动力学与数据分布漂移」分析工具，可能可供核查多步 latent 推理轨迹训练中的目标漂移与贡献分配，但能否迁移到 VLM 场景尚不确定。
